slots.ev: 下雨天她一定去園林走一趟，那天遊客不多但還是有
slots.pl: 蘇州一座園林的迴廊下，下雨天，水面有雨點，這個時間沒有別人
slots.pl_en: under the covered walkway of a Suzhou garden on a rainy day, the water dimpled with rain and nobody else out at this hour
slots.ac: 她一手提著傘收在身側，人停在柱子旁邊看水
slots.ac_en: She has the umbrella closed at her side and has stopped by one of the columns to look at the water.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：下雨天一定去園林走一趟
slots.of: 月白色旗袍，外面罩一件薄外套
slots.of_en: a moon-white qipao with a thin jacket over it
slots.of_s: 色盤：月白／標誌性配額以外的日常旗袍
slots.li: 雨天的光是均勻的灰白，迴廊裡比外面暗
slots.li_en: The rainy-day light is an even grey-white and it is darker under the walkway than outside it.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「光線像宣紙。園林的水、雨、木格窗」
slots.fa_en: Very quiet, watching the surface of the water.
slots.hair_en: in a low coiled bun pinned by herself

slots.ev: 夜裡的老宅臥房，一顆一顆解盤扣
slots.pl: 蘇州老宅的臥房，木格窗，一張老木床，只有一盞燈
slots.pl_en: in the bedroom of the old Suzhou house, a lattice window, an old wooden bed, one lamp
slots.ac: 她站在床邊一顆一顆解開領口的盤扣，動作很慢
slots.ac_en: She is standing by the bed undoing the knotted buttons at the collar one at a time, very slowly.
slots.ac_s: 標誌性配額：旗袍 / 漢服半褪／私下核心：盤扣一顆一顆解開
slots.of: 胭脂紅的絲質旗袍，領口已經解開三顆
slots.of_en: a rouge-red silk qipao with the top three knotted buttons already undone
slots.li: 那一盞燈在她側前方，光像宣紙一樣柔，木格窗與房間深處落暗
slots.li_en: The single lamp is to one side and in front of her, the light as soft as paper, the lattice window and the far side of the room falling dark.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「低飽和、高質感，光線像宣紙」
slots.fa: 眼睛往下看著自己的手
slots.fa_en: Her eyes down on her own hands.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：常常用一句很雅的話講很不雅的事
slots.hair_en: coiled up, with one pin being loosened

slots.ev: 早上自己盤髮，這件事她從不假手他人
slots.pl: 老宅臥房的梳妝檯前，早上，量身的軟尺掛在椅背上
slots.pl_en: at the dressing table in the old house's bedroom in the morning, her tailoring tape hanging over the back of the chair
slots.ac: 她兩手在腦後盤髮，髮簪咬在嘴裡
slots.ac_en: Both hands are behind her head coiling her hair, the pin held in her teeth.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：盤髮永遠自己來，不假手他人／量身的軟尺掛在脖子上一整天
slots.of: 黛青色的絲質內搭，外面還沒套旗袍
slots.of_en: a dark blue-green silk under-layer, the qipao not yet put on over it
slots.li: 木格窗的晨光從側面進來，梳妝檯那一側亮、房間深處暗
slots.li_en: Morning light through the lattice window comes in from the side, bright at the dressing table and dark further into the room.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「低飽和、柔光、留白構圖」
slots.fa_en: Completely absorbed, looking off to the side.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：貼文常常只有四個字
slots.hair_en: halfway into a coil, one long section still loose

slots.ev: 客人走了，長桌上還攤著今天挑的料
slots.pl: 老宅一樓的旗袍店，打烊後，料子攤在長桌上，木格窗外是天井
slots.pl_en: in the qipao workshop on the ground floor of the old house after closing, bolts of cloth spread across the long table, the courtyard visible through the lattice window
slots.ac: 她坐在長桌旁兩手展開一段布，背對木格窗把布舉起來讓光透過去看織紋
slots.ac_en: She is sitting at the long table with a length of cloth open in both hands, her back to the lattice window, holding it up so the light comes through the weave.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：量身、選料、做衣服
slots.of: 竹青色的旗袍，軟尺掛在脖子上
slots.of_en: a bamboo-green qipao with the tailoring tape round her neck
slots.of_s: 色盤：竹青／小習慣：軟尺掛在脖子上一整天
slots.li: 天井的光從她背後的木格窗進來，布被照透，她自己這一面比較暗
slots.li_en: Light from the courtyard comes through the lattice window behind her, shining through the cloth, leaving her own side of it darker.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「園林的水、雨、木格窗」
slots.fa_s: 性格：這件事她做得非常自覺

slots.ev: 夜裡在老木床上，一天結束
slots.pl: 老宅的老木床上，夜裡，床帳的一邊垂下來
slots.pl_en: on the old wooden bed in the old house at night, one side of the bed curtain hanging down
slots.ac: 她側躺在床上，一隻手臂枕在頭下
slots.ac_en: She is lying on her side with one arm folded under her head.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：老宅裡的暗光與木床
slots.of: 月白色的絲質內衣兩件式
slots.li: 床邊那一盞燈在她側前方很低，床帳把光擋掉一半
slots.li_en: The lamp by the bed sits low and to one side and the bed curtain takes out half of what reaches her.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「低飽和、柔光、留白構圖」
slots.fa_en: Looking at the lens completely calmly.
slots.fa_s: 私下核心：完全不靠裸露
slots.hair_en: taken down, long and loose across the pillow
